value.rationale: The small-positive-zealot limit of a recently proposed crisis-opinion contagion model is singular: feedback shifts of order zealot density cause order-one population opinion differences. The theorem also rules out an entire bistability mechanism under reciprocal exponents, in contrast to superlinear q-voter models, and gives an exact measurable parameter crossover with a motivated finite-Z response slope.
